title: Dashboard: Deaths registered weekly in England and Wales: week ending 4 September 2026
meta_description: Visual summary of the provisional weekly death registration figures in England and Wales, including breakdowns by cause and country, and long-term trends

lede: Dashboard showing latest trends in provisional deaths in England and Wales.

body.title: weekly deaths in England and Wales dashboard

body.box_text:
[Deaths registered weekly in England and Wales, provisional](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/birthsdeathsandmarriages/deaths/datasets/weeklyprovisionalfiguresondeathsregisteredinenglandandwales) 
 Dataset 
 Provisional counts of the number of deaths registered in England and Wales, by age, sex, region and Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD), in the latest weeks for which data are available.

body.text: Try the new way to filter and download these data:
[Deaths registered weekly in England and Wales by age and sex](https://www.ons.gov.uk/datasets/weekly-deaths-age-sex)
[Deaths registered weekly in England and Wales by region](https://www.ons.gov.uk/datasets/weekly-deaths-region)

body.box_text:
The process used to produce our weekly deaths data (Reproducible Analytical Pipeline) is now available on GitHub.

[Weekly deaths Reproducible Analytical Pipeline (RAP) on GitHub](https://github.com/ONSdigital/weekly_deaths_rap)

Registered deaths by age, sex, selected underlying causes of death and the leading causes of death. Contains death rates and death registrations by area of usual residence and single year of age.
